li.badLetterText: As punishment for the destruction of a fairy ring, a short cold snap has descended upon you. Let this be a reminder about the importance of protecting nature.\n\nThe spirit of the fairy ring has fled. Any remaining mushrooms may be harvested without consequence.
li.midLetterText: The spirit of the fairy ring has departed. Any remaining mushrooms may be harvested without consequence.
li.goodLetterText: After protecting a fairy ring, your colonists feel calm and happy.\n\nThe spirit of the fairy ring has departed. The mushrooms may now be harvested without consequence.
